label: Morning Routine
title: The Morning Glow-Up
subtitle: A 5-minute ritual to wake up your skin (and your vibe).
description: Mornings hit different when your skin is glowing. This routine is lowkey the easiest way to start your day — quick, clean ingredients, zero stress. Think of it as your daily reset button before the chaos begins.

benefits.title: Instant Wake-Up Glow
benefits.desc: Cold water + vitamin C basically tells your face it's go-time. Puffiness? Gone.

benefits.title: All-Day Hydration Lock
benefits.desc: Layering on damp skin traps moisture so you're dewy, not greasy, by lunch.

benefits.title: SPF = Anti-Aging Cheat Code
benefits.desc: The #1 thing that keeps skin young. No SPF, no glow-up. It's that deep.

benefits.title: Less Breakouts, More Confidence
benefits.desc: A clean, consistent AM routine keeps oil balanced so your skin stops acting up.

benefits.title: 5 Minutes, Zero Excuses
benefits.desc: Short enough to do before your alarm guilt kicks in. Built for busy mornings.

steps: Splash your face with cool water — skip harsh cleanser in the AM, your skin self-cleans overnight.
Pat (don't rub) until skin is just damp, not dry.
Press a few drops of vitamin C serum into your face for that lit-from-within glow.
Lock it in with a lightweight gel moisturizer while skin is still damp.
Finish with SPF 30+. Non-negotiable. This is the main character step.

info.heading: Best time to do it
info.body: Within 10 minutes of waking up, before your skin dries out. Bonus points if you do it right after a shower.

info.heading: Skip if you're acne-prone?
info.body: Nope — just swap the gel moisturizer for an oil-free one and you're set.

faqs.q: Do I really need to wash my face in the morning?
faqs.a: Not always! If you cleansed well at night, a cool water rinse is enough for most people. Oily skin? A gentle gel cleanser won't hurt.

faqs.q: Is vitamin C worth the hype?
faqs.a: Yeah, genuinely. It brightens, fades dark spots, and protects against pollution. Start with a low % so your skin doesn't freak out.

faqs.q: Can I skip SPF on cloudy days?
faqs.a: Absolutely not. UV rays go through clouds and windows. SPF every single day is the cheat code to ageless skin.

faqs.q: How long until I see results?
faqs.a: Glow shows up in days, real changes (dark spots, texture) take 4-6 weeks. Consistency > intensity, always.

proTip: Keep your serum in the fridge. The cold de-puffs your face instantly and the routine feels like a mini spa moment before 8am.
